title: Hastia Additions
description: Hastia Additions add some features like elemental totems, spells, specials effects, and more !
body:
![Features text](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f0c9fbce6d39be964ba69b7075a26838c935ed8b.png)
# **The mod is now in BETA !**

_*Crafts in gallery section_

# Elementals Totems !
Discover the Fire, Air and Earth totems !

**Elementals Totems **introduces a new layer of survival mechanics centered around powerful, craftable totems. Forget the classic Totem of Undying, these totems grant you unique skills, offering a fresh way to prepare for danger.
Each totem gives you unique powers!

## **Fire Totem :**
The fire totem gives you the ability to throw fireballs ! And it also allows you to be immune to fire and gives you a health boost in case of damage.

## **Earth Totem :**
The most powerful totem. You can make an explosion with it. If you died with the Earth totem in your hand, you get an upgraded version of the Totem of Undying. Very useful in PvP.

## **Air Totem :**
When used, the Air Totem gives you feather falling. This will allow you to escape during combat or make big jumps without risk.

![Picture show the Fire, Air and earth totems](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4a3084c79ad4f7d806343a8b8c55c1557c9c3525.png)

# **Spells !**

You can unlock spells! These spells can be used by pressing T and R to select them.
Here are the spells:

**Fire spell:** launch a block of magma that can attack enemies or explode on impact (without destroying any blocks). Unlock when you discover or already discovered the nether !

**Repel Spell:** repels all entities within a 10-block radius of you. This could get you out of many complicated situations. You will obtain it after discovering a Nether Fortress.

 
# **Specials Effects !**

Specials effects are effects that you can earn in exchange for resources, in order to gain semi-permanent effects that you will lose if you die. By opening the menu with “O,” you will have access to the different effects that you can obtain:

      - Regeneration: Faster healing during combat and exploration.
      - Resistance: Passive damage reduction to help you survive tough fights.
      - DRAGON EFFECT! Give you the skill to throw dragon fireball, with multiples effects.
      - And more effects will be available in the future.

# **A new way to mine !**

The reinforced pickaxe is better than netherite pickaxe ! This pickaxe allows you to break blocks very quickly and instantly with an efficiency 5! It is more resistant and makes it easier to dig in survival mode.
And the reinforced shovel, better than the netherite one ! You can instant breack blocks with it.

![Picture show the reinforced pickaxe and reinforced shovel](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/69d46a10d7d510d2e3424aa17212fd4dd925ebdb_0.webp)
 
# **Possibility to craft light block !**

The mod add a way to craft invisible light block, which are normally only available with commands. Very interesting for people who don't like torches and who play survival mode.

![Beta phase text](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6f63ef3278c047882964fa05a5eb36e12bb3fd86.png)
 
**This mod is currently under development. So there will be several content updates in the coming months.**
